  "plan": "# Professional Website for Avery Chan\n\n## Stack\n\n- Next.js 16.4 (App Router, TypeScript), React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, `motion` for animation, fonts via `next/font`.\n- No backend, no database, no environment variables. Nothing is added that is not in the CV.\n- **Stack and skills**: SQL, Python, Databricks (PySpark), Airflow, Docker, GCP, Azure Data Factory, GitHub Actions, grouped with the skill areas (ETL/ELT, warehousing, migration, cloud architecture, performance and cost optimisation).\n- **Credentials**: Data Engineering on Microsoft Azure (02/2024), AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (02/2023), SAS Certified Base Programmer (04/2018), BBA Business Analysis with a minor in Computer Science, City University of Hong Kong (09/2016 to 07/2018).\n- **Portfolio**: three \"coming soon\" cards (for example: pipeline case studies, writing, open-source). <think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
I'm treating this as a static page and moving on to the design foundation. I've settled on a near-black background, off-white text, a muted grey for secondary text, a faint white line color, and a lime accent. For typography, Geist is serviceable but generic, so I'm leaning toward Inter Tight for headlines paired with JetBrains Mono.

Tightening the font choice: I'll go with Inter Tight for display and body, paired with JetBrains Mono, and I'll run the dev build with full network access so Google Fonts can load. Next I'm writing the globals.css theme, including the grid background, SVG noise, selection colors, smooth scrolling, and reduced-motion handling, and I'm checking whether the muted-grey contrast holds up against the background.

I'm laying out the layout system next: a container class capped at 1280px with responsive side padding, a fixed grid backdrop with a radial fade, a soft accent glow in the hero, and a faint noise overlay. I'm also planning a reusable section heading with a mono index label and hairline, and sketching the hero, with a large two-line name and a pipeline-status card on the right.

I'm putting together the hero's terminal-style pipeline card, with staggered line reveals, in the right column on large screens. I'm also sketching a meta strip below it for location, status and stack, and planning a fixed, blurred nav with a mono logo, section links, a contact button, and a compact mobile menu.

I'm making the page responsive, using motion's whileInView for the reveal animations, with a MotionConfig wrapper that respects reduced motion. I'm also planning a count-up component for the stat numbers.

I'm now settling on how the count-up numbers will work: starting at zero, animating to the real value once they scroll into view, and jumping straight to the final number when reduced motion is on. The journey timeline will have a vertical line whose fill grows with scroll progress, with each role laid out as a grid row.

I'm now working out the journey timeline's layout. Each role will be an article with a left column for the period and a node on a continuous rail, and I'm weighing whether to position the rail with fixed offsets or just give each row its own line segment.

I'm settling the timeline rail: each role gets its own vertical line segment with a fill driven by that item's scroll progress, and the node lights up in the accent color once it starts filling. The last item will end its line differently, so the rail doesn't just stop abruptly.

I'm sketching the journey section's role cards: each one gets a header with the organization, title, and an active badge for the current role, plus a short summary and a few of the strongest highlights. I'm keeping the card layout consistent across breakpoints, with the period shown beside the card on desktop and inside it on mobile.

I'm weighing the Hotmob entry down to four bullets, since the plan calls for two to four. I'd rather keep the Docker, Airflow and CI/CD detail than drop it, so I'm folding those into one line about containerised jobs and centralised logging.

I'm settling the Hotmob entry at four bullets, since the plan asks for two to four of the strongest. I'll merge the pipeline consolidation with the Docker, Airflow and CI/CD delivery detail into one line and drop the BI point to keep the count down. The other roles already fit within that limit.

I'm sketching the impact section as a four-column grid with bordered cells, each showing a large accent-coloured number, a label and a short detail. For the stack, I'm planning a heading on the left, with three groups of chips on the right and a skills list below. Credentials will be three cards plus a wider education card, and the portfolio will be three cards marked "Coming soon" with index numbers and arrows. The contact section gets a large email link, and the footer will skip the year so it avoids calling the current date during server rendering.

I'm sketching the section ids and nav links, with Credentials kept out of the nav, and numbering the sections 01 through 07. Next I'll write the globals and layout files, starting with the providers.

node shoot.mjs 1440 d 2&gt;&amp;1 | tail -10; ls; echo $PWD</summary>
```bash
cd "$TMPDIR/shots" && cat > shoot.mjs <<'EOF'
import { chromium } from "playwright";

const [, , widthArg = "1440", tag = "d", ...only] = process.argv;
const width = Number(widthArg);
const height = width < 600 ? 844 : 900;
const browser = await chromium.launch();
const ctx = await browser.newContext({
  viewport: { width, height },
  deviceScaleFactor: 1,
  isMobile: width < 600,
});
const page = await ctx.newPage();
const errors = [];
page.on("console", (m) => {
  if (m.type() === "error") errors.push(m.text());
});
page.on("pageerror", (e) => errors.push(String(e)));
await page.goto("http://localhost:3000/", { waitUntil: "networkidle" });
await page.waitForTimeout(2500);
await page.screenshot({ path: `${tag}-hero.png` });

const total = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollHeight);
for (let y = 0; y < total; y += 350) {
  await page.evaluate((yy) => window.scrollTo({ top: yy, behavior: "instant" }), y);
  await page.waitForTimeout(120);
}
await page.waitForTimeout(1500);

const ids = ["about", "impact", "journey", "stack", "credentials", "portfolio", "contact"];
for (const id of ids) {
  if (only.length && !only.includes(id)) continue;
  const el = page.locator(`#${id}`);
  await el.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await page.waitForTimeout(1800);
  await el.screenshot({ path: `${tag}-${id}.png` });
}

const overflow = await page.evaluate(
  () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth,
);
console.log("horizontal overflow px:", overflow, "total height:", total);
console.log("errors:", errors.length ? errors : "none");
await browser.close();
EOF
node shoot.mjs 1440 d 2>&1 | tail -10; ls; echo $PWD
```
